details:
Thank you to the VRChat team for your continued hard work and for constantly improving the platform. Your dedication to making VRChat a better experience for everyone is greatly appreciated.

I would like to suggest an improvement to the sticker visibility system.

This request applies only to stickers that comply with the VRChat Community Guidelines. It is not intended to restrict the use of stickers, but rather to provide users with better tools for personal comfort and self-protection, similar to other existing Safety features.

[Persistent Hidden State]

Currently, if I hide stickers that have already been placed, they become visible again the next time I log into VRChat. This means I have to repeatedly hide the same stickers every session.

It would greatly improve the user experience if the hidden state could persist across sessions until the user chooses to change it. This would eliminate repetitive actions while allowing users to maintain their preferred viewing experience.

[Per-User Sticker Visibility]

The current Safety settings allow stickers to be shown or hidden based on Player Rank, but this is often too broad. Within the same rank, there may be users whose stickers I enjoy seeing and others whose stickers I would prefer not to see.

If possible, I would love to have a per-user sticker visibility toggle, similar to the existing Show/Hide Avatar option in the User Actions menu. This would allow users to individually choose whether stickers from a specific user are displayed or hidden.

This feature would not limit anyone's ability to use guideline-compliant stickers. Instead, it would simply give each user more control over what they personally choose to see, aligning with VRChat's existing philosophy of user choice and customizable Safety features.

Thank you very much for considering this suggestion.
title: Improve Sticker Visibility Controls (Persistent Hide & Per-User Toggle)
